result: At pinned modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, crates/rmcp/tests/test_stateless_server_requests.rs directly exercises multiple requests over one live duplex server connection. A metadata-complete Discover request followed by a metadata-missing ListTools request is rejected with INVALID_PARAMS, so prior request metadata is not silently reused. A separate same-connection test sends first-client then second-client in per-request clientInfo and RequestContext::client_info() records them in that order. This gives executable evidence that the tested stateless request context refreshes client identity per request rather than reusing stale prior-request metadata.
